fields.description: URL that tenants and hosted sites use to reach Suite Cloud. Blank uses this site's URL. On a development machine, use a tunnel URL.
fields.label: Public URL

fields.description: Treat tenant domains as verified without a DNS check. For development only. Never use on a shared cluster.
fields.label: Skip Domain Verification

fields.description: Time limit for install, bootstrap and upgrade jobs. 1800 = 30 minutes.
fields.label: Server Job Timeout (Seconds)

fields.description: Days to keep DMARC reports. Stalwart deletes its copy after 30 days.
fields.label: DMARC Report Retention (Days)

fields.description: Days to keep TLS reports. Stalwart deletes its copy after 30 days.
fields.label: TLS Report Retention (Days)

fields.description: Days to keep sending counts for the Sending Usage dashboard.
fields.label: Sending Usage Retention (Days)
Tenant Email
fields.description: Connected sites send mail such as invites and password resets through Suite Cloud.
Outgoing Email Account for each tenant type. Sites of a type with no account cannot send mail.
fields.label: Email Accounts

fields.description: e.g. Acme <noreply@example.com>. Off uses the Email Account name.
fields.label: Use Tenant Title as Sender Name

fields.description: The agent runs on each Stalwart node and egress gateway. It sends logs and metrics to Suite Cloud.
fields.label: Agent

fields.description: Per agent.
fields.label: Agent Requests per Minute

fields.description: Log events, metric samples or usage records in one request.
fields.label: Agent Records per Request

fields.description: Retries for a batch after a server or network failure. Rate limits do not count.
fields.label: Agent Max Attempts

fields.description: How often the agent collects metrics.
fields.label: Metrics Interval (Seconds)

fields.description: Send old log files the first time the agent starts. Off sends only new lines.
fields.label: Ship Existing Logs

fields.description: Days to keep a sent log file. 0 keeps it. The node deletes logs after 14 days in any case.
fields.label: Delete Shipped Logs After (Days)

fields.description: Version that provisioning installs.
fields.label: Built Agent Version

fields.description: Agents send logs and metrics to the telemetry API. A loader copies them into Insights.
fields.label: Telemetry

fields.description: Run the agent on each Stalwart node and egress gateway. Changing it queues an Install Agent job on each server.
fields.label: Enable Telemetry

fields.description: Days to keep events and metrics in Insights.
fields.label: Telemetry Retention (Days)

fields.description: Checked every five minutes. An alert opens for a node that stops reporting or logs too many errors.
fields.label: Telemetry Alerts

fields.description: Emails to notify, separated by commas or lines. Blank records alerts without email.
fields.label: Telemetry Alert Recipients

fields.description: A node with no data for this long gets a Silent Host alert.
fields.label: Silent Host After (Minutes)

fields.description: A node with more errors than this share of its events in the last hour gets an alert. Needs at least 100 events.
fields.label: Error Rate Alert (%)

fields.description: Stalwart release for new clusters, e.g. v0.16.20.
fields.label: Stalwart Version

fields.description: {version} is the release and {target} the platform, e.g. x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.
fields.label: Stalwart Download URL Template

fields.description: Spam filter rules a new cluster imports, e.g. v3.0.1. Change it with the Stalwart Version. Blank imports the latest.
fields.label: Spam Filter Rules Version

fields.description: stalwart-cli release used to bootstrap a cluster, e.g. v1.0.12.
fields.label: Stalwart CLI Version

fields.description: Same placeholders as the Stalwart URL. {target} is the static build, e.g. x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.
fields.label: Stalwart CLI Download URL Template

fields.description: Turn off only on a development site whose cluster uses a staging certificate.
fields.label: Verify Stalwart TLS Certificates

fields.description: Add an Ed25519 DKIM key next to the RSA key. Applies to new domains only. Many receivers ignore Ed25519.
fields.label: Sign with Ed25519 as well as RSA

fields.description: Certificate authority for clusters. For testing, use the Let's Encrypt staging URL.
fields.label: ACME Directory URL

fields.description: Gets notices about expiring certificates.
fields.label: ACME Contact Email

fields.description: Used when a DNS Zone has no TTL. Also suggested to tenants.
fields.label: Default DNS TTL (Seconds)

fields.description: Frappe Cloud control plane, e.g. https://central.frappe.cloud.
fields.label: Central URL

fields.description: Team that owns the Suite Cloud servers. Enter the URL, key and secret first. The user needs server:create, server:view, cluster:view and server:console.
fields.label: Central Team

fields.description: Region for signups that name no region. Run Sync Regions and enable a region first.
fields.label: Default Region

fields.description: Image offering for new servers.
fields.label: Image Offering

fields.description: Plan for new servers. Blank uses the first plan in the region.
fields.label: Plan

fields.description: Most sites on one server, Suite sites and others together.
fields.label: Max Sites per Server

fields.description: A region with fewer free slots gets a new server, at most one per hour.
fields.label: Minimum Free Site Slots

fields.description: Add a server when a region runs low on free slots. Each server is billed.
fields.label: Create Servers Automatically

fields.description: Sites per server = (memory - reserved) / memory per site, or the same for disk, whichever is lower.
fields.label: Server Sizing

fields.description: Memory for Frappe, MariaDB, Redis and workers before any site.
fields.label: Memory Reserved for the Server (MB)

fields.description: Disk for the system, bench and apps before any site.
fields.label: Disk Reserved for the Server (GB)

fields.description: Git repository of the Suite app.
fields.label: Repository

fields.description: Used by new servers only.
fields.label: Branch or Tag

fields.description: Sites kept ready in each region so a signup gets a site at once. 0 creates sites on demand.
fields.label: Ready Sites per Region

fields.description: Accept signups through the public signup API.
fields.label: Allow Signup

fields.description: Accept signup emails with a +tag, e.g. john+test@example.com. The owner account on the site does not get the tag.
fields.label: Allow Sub-addressed Emails at Signup

fields.description: Each site gets its label under this zone, e.g. acme.example.app. Needs a DNS provider.
fields.label: Site DNS Zone

fields.description: Each tenant gets its label under this zone as its mail domain, e.g. acme.example.com. Needs a DNS provider. Must not be a Stalwart cluster zone.
fields.label: Tenant Mail Zone
